Nice price. Nice Set. No use!. [[VIDEOID:8ee286ac50c67ae00b30690bf2bbe82c]] My 2-year-old Sonicare toothbrush is making some odd noises after being accidentally dropped. I’ve used electric toothbrushes for over 20 years. So, when I saw this toothbrush set in my Amazon Vine listing, I thought I’d try it as a potential replacement. As an Amazon Vine reviewer, I am offered new-to-market products, if I want them, at no cost to me, in exchange for an honest, objective, and comprehensive review.
At $25 for two electric toothbrushes and 10 brush heads, this seems to be a superb value. Too good to be true? – ABSOLUTELY! You really do get what you pay for.
.
DESIGN:
.
The brush heads are attached via a bayonet fitting to the top of the toothbrush. The fit works OK. The bristles are very soft. The product description does state soft. There’s no color indicator for when to replace the heads. The manual states to do it when the bristles are worn and bent over.
.
The toothbrush itself is fairly light but will stand up on its end without issue. Charging, recommended every 10-14 days, is achieved by removing a bayonet cap at the bottom and plugging in the proprietary USB-C charging cable (no charging brick included). The LED will glow red. However, it does not seem to turn off when a full charge is achieved. Plugged in – LED always glows red.
There is a selector button. Press once to turn ON. Long press to turn OFF. Once ON, a button press will cycle through the various vibration modes. If you long press to turn the unit OFF, when restarting, the toothbrush does remember the last mode setting. I found it all too easy though to change the mode when turning the unit OFF, by forgetting to long press!
The vibration modes really don’t change much other than a little maximum intensity variation and a slight change in the variable vibration pattern. There is a noticeable long pause at the 30 second intervals. You briefly think the toothbrush has turned off. To be honest, I’ve never used the different modes on my other electric toothbrushes. .

.
CONCLUSION:
.
Nice price. Comprehensive set. No use.
.

So, in the future, I'll take my wifey advice: " Buy the name brand." She's had a name brand for over two years with no cracking, no problems.
